<noinclude>
This is the "Protocol" form.

To create a page with this form, enter the page name below;
if a page with that name already exists, you will be sent to a form to edit that page.

{{#forminput:form=Protocol|autocomplete on category=Protocol}}
</noinclude>
<includeonly>
<div id="wikiPreview" style="display: none; padding-bottom: 25px; margin-bottom: 25px; border-bottom: 1px solid #AAAAAA;"></div>

{{{for template|Protocol}}}

{| class="formtable"
|-
! Protocol Title:
| {{{field|title|mandatory|input type=text|size=80}}}
|-
! Category:
| {{{field|category|mandatory|input type=dropdown|values=Safety,Experimental,Maintenance,Quality Control,Data Analysis,Other}}}
|-
! Version:
| {{{field|version|mandatory|input type=text|size=20|default=1.0}}}
|-
! Author:
| {{{field|author|mandatory|input type=combobox|values from category=Personnel|autocomplete on property=Personnel Role}}}
|-
! Created Date:
| {{{field|created_date|mandatory|input type=date}}}
|-
! Last Review Date:
| {{{field|last_review_date|mandatory|input type=date}}}
|-
! Next Review Date:
| {{{field|next_review_date|mandatory|input type=date}}}
|-
! Status:
| {{{field|status|mandatory|input type=dropdown|values=Active,Inactive,Under Review|default=Active}}}
|-
! Required Equipment:
| {{{field|required_equipment|input type=checkboxes|values from category=Equipment|delimiter=;}}}
|-
! Required Certifications:
| {{{field|required_certifications|input type=checkboxes|values from category=Safety Certification|delimiter=;}}}
|-
! Related Protocols:
| {{{field|related_protocols|input type=checkboxes|values from category=Protocol|delimiter=;}}}
|}

{{{end template}}}

'''Free text:'''

{{{standard input|free text|rows=15}}}
</includeonly>
